name: SANDJEST Nurse 20 oz Insulated Coffee Tumbler
seoTitle: Nurse 20 oz Insulated Coffee Tumbler Gift
metaDescription: A 20 oz insulated stainless steel nurse coffee tumbler for nurses and nursing students. A budget friendly gift for Nurses Week, graduation, or a birthday.
summary: A 20 oz insulated nurse coffee tumbler that fits a commute and a locker shelf. A budget friendly gift for nurses and nursing students.
whyItWorks: Not every nurse wants a giant cup. A 20 oz tumbler holds a solid coffee order without feeling bulky, and it slides more easily into a car cup holder or a crowded locker. For a nurse who brews at home before a 12 hour shift, an insulated stainless steel cup helps that first coffee stay warm a while longer, which is a small comfort during a busy morning med pass.

The size also makes it a natural choice for nursing students, who carry coffee from class to clinicals and do not want something that weighs down a backpack. Many shoppers like the nurse themed label in this line, but check the listing photos to see the design on this exact cup before ordering. It is budget friendly, so it works for a group of coworkers during Nurses Week or as part of a graduation basket.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the design and lid style on this specific tumbler.

faq.q: Is 20 oz a good size for a nurse?
faq.a: It is a comfortable size for coffee and fits most cup holders. Nurses who want to carry a full day of water may prefer a 32 or 40 oz option.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes, it is easy to carry between class and clinicals, and it suits a student who runs on coffee.
